target_customer: Teams running AI agents and coding agents that use many model providers
problem: Hundreds of models and providers with changing prices and failure modes, and agents act faster than people can review. Conifer is a gateway and router that picks models by task and cost, plus a reviewer for agent-written code.
business_model: usage-based API gateway and router, plus Parallax code review product
product_category: LLM gateway, router and agent code review

founders.name: Charles Muehlberger
prior_employers: DoW (edge AI devices for RF brain injury modeling, as written on YC page)
founders.background_notes: Per YC company page; education not listed

prior_employers: Dell Med Institute of Vascular Surgery (clinical researcher)
previous_startups: The HeartCheck Foundation (co-founder, free hypertension screenings)
founders.background_notes: Per YC company page; education not listed

competitors.name: OpenRouter
competitors.what: Unified API for many models with routing
competitors.traction_then: Market leading gateway, one unconfirmed listing says Stripe agreed to acquire it in August 2026

competitors.name: Martian
competitors.what: Model router and gateway with integrations for Cursor and Cline
competitors.traction_then: Active, runs a Code Review Bench

competitors.name: Not Diamond
competitors.what: Intelligent model router that powers OpenRouter Auto mode

technical_complexity.rationale: Gateway infrastructure is standard, while routing quality and code review quality require evaluation work.

defensibility.rationale: Many gateways and routers existed already and a PitchBook piece questioned whether routers are a dead end.

market_need_then: Token bills were rising and teams used many models, so multiple router startups raised money in 2026 (for example Sapiom and TrustedRouter coverage).

branding.domain_note: Uses conifer.build, not a .com. The name collides with a funded electric motor startup called Conifer and the Rhizome web archive Conifer.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and mission-focused on keeping accountable people in command of agents

brand_strength.rationale: Name overlaps several other Conifer entities, so funding and news searches return the wrong companies.

outcome_analysis: Conifer is an active Summer 2026 company with no exit or shutdown found for conifer.build. It enters a crowded gateway and router market, and its Parallax code reviewer may be the differentiator. Name collisions with other Conifer companies complicate the public record.
notes: Company site says backed by Y Combinator, Gradient, SciFi VC, Link Ventures, Perceptive Ventures and UpScaleX plus angels, with no amounts, dates or stages, so no round recorded. Dealroom lists a 125K USD seed (aggregator only, unverified). CB Insights shows a 20M USD seed from April 2025, but that is a different Conifer (electric motors). Nothing found on outcome for this company. Parallax benchmark numbers come from the company and a blog.
